I’m VERY new to false eyelashes. These are very pretty. It took me a few hours of practice to get them placed so they looked natural. The tool seems straight forward but it took as much practice placing the lashes for installation as it did getting them on my eyes. There were NO instructions for how to use the included tool either with would have made this much easier. Over all once I figured it all out I love them. The give my putter eye lift which is why I bought them.

Pretty & very lite weight but being only half sized, they do not look right on my eyes at all. And they are not easy to put on either...the tool included is useless, they stick to it. I will be initiating a return for this set & try with a full set.

I understand that I purchased a cheaper product with expectations of high quality so that is my bad on that part. reviews.t: The lashes came perfectly packaged and none of them were damaged
reviews.x: The lashes came perfectly packaged and none of them were damaged. They are easy to apply once you get the hang of it (practice before you plan to wear them out!) These magnetic eyelashes make me wear falsies more often

reviews.t: This eyelash material feels comfortable and looks natural
reviews.x: This eyelash material feels comfortable and looks natural. There are 2 magnets on each lash and they are shorter (not the actual lashes the length of the strip) which makes them easier to put on and keep straight.
Very hard to apply.. I’ve been wearing false lashes for years. The amount of time and effort put into applying these magnetic lashes is equivalent to lash glue. I am not satisfied with this purchase.
These lashes stay put! I went to the county fair in my home town wondering how they’d hold up, well I went on some crazy fast rides and they didn’t budge! Great for the price and will buy again!
I absolutely love them. Took some time to get used to putting them on, but eventually got it. Love how they open my eye. You do need eyeliner with them because the magnets are so dark.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes difficult to apply and requiring practice, though some say it gets easier with time.
Reviewers praise the look, length, and curl of the lashes, calling them pretty and natural-looking once applied.
Several reviewers report problems with the included applicator/tweezer tool, saying lashes stick to it or it is flimsy and useless.
Some reviewers note the lashes are only half-length or accent lashes, which some like but others find looks weird.
A few reviewers report quality issues such as magnets on the wrong side, a magnet coming off, or lashes being too heavy.
